blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Citizens who need to register for or update their National ID have until September 26, 2026 to avail round-the-clock services at the Cebu City 24/7 Government Services Hub. The Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) Cebu Provincial Statistical Office is providing the 24-hour National ID services from September 21 to 26, with an additional overnight shift from 11 p.m. to 6 a.m. READ: Cebu City’s 24/7 hub: What to bring for National ID services The service is available at the second floor of Cebu Exchange Tower along Salinas Drive in Barangay Lahug, Cebu City, across Cebu I.T.
